titles.title: Black Door with Red

credit_line: Chrysler Museum of Art, Norfolk, Virginia Bequest of Walter P. Chrysler, Jr. 89.63
description: A wide, rectangular strip of red and orange fills the frame, with two thin strips of yellow above and below. A black square sits at the center of the composition. Below the square, small orange rectangles run across the composition. The composition depicts an adobe wall with a black door at its center and a path of square tiles running below it.
